body_markdown:
A big update to Hana's design tools. The 3D transform tools introduced last year get a big overhaul: you can now turn objects in 3D directly on the canvas, with a rotation handle, a selection box that follows the object, and a new 3D Transform panel. Auto layout gets a Grid mode, layers can have multiple fills, and files have a version history. There is also a command palette, line and arrow tools, variable-width strokes, text on a path, outline mode, find and replace, and multi-page PDF export. Read the[blog post](https://spline.design/blog/hana-design-tools-update) for a full walkthrough.


## Changes


**3D transform**


- **Selection box that follows the object** - When an object is turned in 3D, its selection box, resize handles and corner radius handles turn with it. The original flat box stays as a dotted outline behind it.
- **Rotation handle on the canvas** - Three rings appear on the object when you hover it or while the 3D panel is open. Drag a ring to turn the object around that axis, or drag inside the rings to turn it freely.
- **3D Transform in the Effects panel** - 3D Transform has moved from the Transform panel to the Effects panel, right below 3D Shape. Its icon opens a panel with Rotation, Depth, Perspective, Flatten and Backface, and a cube you can drag to rotate the layer.
- **3D shape effect** - Its rotation handle has the same new look, with the half of each ring behind the object faded.


**Layout**


- **Grid layout** - A fourth auto layout mode, next to Row, Column and Wrap. Tracks can be a fixed size, a share of the free space (` 1fr` ) or` auto` , and children can span several columns or rows. Set the grid's dimensions with a picker in the Layout panel. Exports to HTML as CSS grid.
- **Aspect ratio lock** - The lock is now saved with the layer. The size fields, the resize handles and auto layout all keep the ratio.
- **Min and max sizes** - Set a minimum and maximum width and height on auto-layout frames and their children.
- **Baseline alignment** - Align text of different sizes in a row.
- **Stacking order** - Choose whether the first or the last child is drawn on top when children overlap.
- **Strokes in layout** - Choose whether a frame's stroke takes up space in its layout.


**Fills, strokes and effects**


- **Multiple fills per layer** - Stack colors and gradients on one layer, each with its own opacity, visibility and blend mode. Stacked fills are included in SVG, PDF and HTML exports.
- **Diamond gradients** for fills and strokes.
- **Fill blend mode** - A blend mode on the fill alone, separate from the layer's.
- **Strokes** - Multiple strokes on one layer, per-side stroke widths on rectangles and frames, and a miter limit.
- **Shadow spread** for drop and inner shadows.
- **Display P3** - Set a document's color profile to sRGB or Display P3.


**Vector tools**


- **Line (L) and Arrow (⇧L) tools** , with arrowheads for the start and end of a stroke.
- **Variable-width strokes** - Make a stroke thicker or thinner anywhere along its length with the Width tool (⇧W), or pick a preset.
- **Text on a path** - Put text on any path, then offset it, flip it to the other side or detach it.
- **Point editing** - Mirroring modes for handles, a lasso (Q) to select points, ⌘J to join two open ends, Simplify Vector and Offset Path.
- **Exclude boolean** , ⌘E to flatten and ⌥⌘O to outline a stroke.
- **Place image (⇧⌘K)** - Pick files, then click to place them.


**Version history**


- **Version History panel** - Browse a file's versions and preview any of them on the canvas. Save named versions, rename them, duplicate one as a new file, or restore one. Saving and restoring versions requires a paid plan.


**Commands and selection**


- **Command palette (⌘K)** - Search every command in the editor, including Ask Agent.
- **Keyboard shortcuts panel (⌃⇧?)** - A list of every shortcut, which also tracks the ones you have used.
- **Find and replace (⌘F)** for layer names and text, and **batch rename** .
- **Selection** - ⌘A selects the siblings of the current selection, and ⇧⌘A inverts it. Enter moves into a layer's children, ⇧Enter goes back up to the parent, and Tab steps through siblings. Select matching layers (⌥⌘A), or everything with the same fill, stroke, effect or font.
- **Selection colors** - One panel lists every color in the selection.
- **Clipboard** - Paste over the selection (⇧⌘V), paste to replace (⇧⌘R), and copy as PNG, SVG, CSS or HTML.
- **Duplicate and layer shortcuts** - ⌘D repeats the offset of your last duplicate. ⌘\] and ⌘\[ move a layer up and down the stack, ⇧⌘H hides it and ⇧⌘L locks it.


**Canvas and export**


- **Outline mode (⌘Y)** - Draws every layer as a thin outline.
- **Pixel preview** - See the page in real pixels, at 1x or 2x.
- **Hand tool (H)** and zoom shortcuts: ⌘+, ⌘−, ⇧1 to fit the page, ⇧2 to fit the selection.
- **Multi-page PDF** - Select several frames and export them as one PDF, with a page for each frame.


**Fixes**


- Strokes on rounded rectangles and frames no longer show stepped corners while the corner radius is being changed.
- The Edit Effect panel's header now stays in place while its settings scroll, and its Presets menu is aligned with it.
- Other improvements and fixes.
